pezzi.35: From a single agent to a team
pezzi.36: Three shapes I build and keep in service: an agent that prepares and publishes content, an agent inside an application, a group of agents that split the work and check each other.
pezzi.38: It proposes, waits, publishes. The proposals come from the material of the week, and each one states the source it comes from.
pezzi.39: Make me a carousel of 5 posts for Instagram
pezzi.42: Three proposals from the material of the week. Each one is a carousel of five panels:
pezzi.47: What came out this week and what changes for people at work
pezzi.50: Price per token against cost per task: the real arithmetic
pezzi.53: Five levels, and why the fifth is not a guarantee
pezzi.55: Go with the second one, drier tone
pezzi.58: Five panels written: opening with the number, two of comparison, one with the sum worked out, closing with the question. Alt text included.
pezzi.59: AWAITING APPROVAL · I publish only after your yes
pezzi.60: The creative part stays with the person who signs the profile. The agent’s job is to prepare, to order and to wait.
pezzi.62: Not a chat bolted on the side: an agent that sits inside the product and does one precise thing, with the permissions of the user who called it and not with its own.
pezzi.64: The permissions are those of whoever asks
pezzi.66: Declared in the code, not improvised
pezzi.68: If it cannot, it says so and stops
pezzi.69: Prepare the summary of the month for tomorrow’s meeting
pezzi.72: Summary ready: receipts, open invoices, three late orders. Every number with the read that produces it.
pezzi.75: REJECTED · one value does not trace back to any read
pezzi.76: Corrected: the estimated margin was removed and declared missing. The rest passed the check.
pezzi.79: The verifier has read-only permissions and no interest in declaring the work finished.
pezzi.81: One executes, one verifies. The verifier checks that every number traces back to a read: when it does not, it rejects, and the work goes back.
pezzi.83: The one who executes is not the one who verifies.
pezzi.85: A team of agents is not right for everything: it adds steps, time and cost. I use it where a silent error costs more than the extra complexity, and I say so when it is not the case.
pezzi.88: The updated test bench, and the criterion I use to choose the model for a task.
